title: Cross-Cultural Value Awareness in Large Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LVLMs to generate moral, ethical, and political values for individuals using counterfactual images of the same person placed in different religious contexts (e.g., Christian church, Mosque, Hindu temple). The outputs are evaluated using Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) categorizations, value sensitivity via Jaccard overlap, and lexical analysis based on the Stereotype Content Model (warmth and competence).

Prompting LVLMs to generate moral, ethical, and political values for individuals using counterfactual images of the same person placed in different national contexts (e.g., Brazil, China, Germany). The outputs are evaluated using MFT categorizations, Jaccard overlap for context sensitivity, and SCM lexical analysis.

Prompting LVLMs to generate moral, ethical, and political values for individuals using counterfactual images of the same person depicted in different socioeconomic contexts (low, middle, and high income). The outputs are evaluated using MFT categorizations, Jaccard overlap for context sensitivity, and SCM lexical analysis.
